title: Kojic Acid Cream Side Effects: What to Watch For
ex: Most kojic acid cream side effects are mild, like stinging or dryness. Learn which reactions are normal, which mean stop, and how to lower the risk.
rt: Kojic Acid Cream Side Effects to Know | Mirc Glow
rd: Kojic acid cream side effects explained: common stinging and dryness, rarer allergic rashes, who should take care, and simple steps to use it more gently.
quick: The most common kojic acid cream side effects are mild stinging, redness, dryness or flaking in the first weeks. Itching, a rash or swelling can mean an allergic reaction, so stop and see a doctor if it does not settle. Patch test, start slowly and wear sunscreen daily.
facts: Creams usually contain about 1–2% kojic acid.
Irritation can leave darker-looking marks on deeper skin tones.
Allergic reactions can appear after weeks of use, not only on day one.
Kojic acid can turn brownish with air and light, so store it closed and shaded.
